title: HR starter
description: Recruiting and people tools, plus prompts for fair CV screening, job ads, policy answers, scorecards and onboarding plans.

apps.name: Screen this CV
apps.prompt: Compare the CV or profile on this page with the role {{ask: Which role? | the job description in my files}}: must-have skills met and missing, relevant experience, and gaps to explore, plus 5 tailored interview questions. Judge only job-related evidence; ignore age, gender, ethnicity, photos and other protected characteristics.

apps.name: Write a job ad
apps.prompt: Write an inclusive job ad for {{ask: Job title?}}: a short summary, 6 responsibilities, must-haves separated from nice-to-haves, benefits and how to apply. Avoid gendered or exclusionary wording.

apps.name: Answer from policy
apps.prompt: Search my files (policies, handbook) and answer this employee question: {{ask: The question?}} Quote the policy section and name the file. If the files don't cover it, say so.

apps.name: Interview scorecard
apps.prompt: Create a structured interview scorecard for {{ask: Role?}}: 5 competencies, 2 questions for each, and a 1 to 5 rating guide that describes what each score looks like.

apps.name: 30-60-90 onboarding
apps.prompt: Draft a 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for {{ask: Role and team?}} with goals, key meetings, training and check-ins for each stage.

apps.name: Candidate email
apps.prompt: Draft a warm email to the candidate on this page to {{ask: Purpose? | invite them to an interview}}, with clear next steps and a placeholder for times. Open it as a draft in my mail app.

apps.name: Summarise feedback
apps.prompt: Summarise the survey or feedback on this page: the top themes, overall sentiment, a few representative quotes (no names) and 3 suggested actions.
